scope: Provider-free relay admission and load-balancing hardening follow-up.
patterns: least-request style local reservations with stable fairness under burst load
strict token and request-slot admission before lease creation
bounded waiting-room depth with explicit overflow shedding
single coalesced wake-up for queued admissions instead of one timer per caller
absolute deadline handling for queued work
cooldown exclusion and recovery admission without provider probes
seeded fake-clock state-machine exploration with replay traces
bounded synthetic MMO staging to exercise heterogeneous user behavior

verification.synthetic_load_suite: 10/10 passed; smoke, stress and war tiers are deterministic and provider-free
verification.synthetic_scale: smoke 16,798 operations; stress 45,402 operations; war 101,125 operations
continuous_invariants: queue depth <= 500 and empty-queue wake timers are cancelled
no duplicate lease IDs, double admissions or terminal requests retaining leases
in-flight counts, reserved tokens and request capacity never become invalid
cooling, depleted, paused and unavailable accounts receive no prohibited admission
queued requests reach exactly one terminal state and traffic eventually quiesces
healthy and recovered accounts continue making progress under saturation
verification.invariant_assertions: smoke >= 8,386; stress >= 28,888; war >= 65,090, plus queue-case terminal assertions
verification.failures_discovered: No relay invariant violations; no production behavior change was required by the war-game expansion.
verification.production_changes: None for this expansion. The existing local pool admission hardening was exercised by the suite.
verification.network_safety: Zero provider, generation, authority/Supabase and external network requests; shared telemetry egress is disabled at the test seam.
verification.documentation_check: passed; ACT-022 remains an unrelated overdue advisory

limits: The harness uses synthetic schedulers, accounts and central dependencies; it does not prove physical provider throughput or availability.
No real generation request, provider connection, Supabase call or external network request was issued by the load suite.
